verdict.rationale: Rippling's payroll docs say it automatically calculates payroll taxes and files them with the correct federal, state, and local agencies on time, which covers multi-state withholding and filing. Location-based rules are also applied to labor policies per work location. Missing for 10: any evidence of state tax registration or account setup for new states, detail on how per-employee state withholding is determined (e.g. work vs. residence state, reciprocity), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
